delivered: ONE BACKUP SYSTEM (D65): scd's encrypted engine for scheduled, manual, pre-change and pre-restore backups (age to the key holders as written, verified by loading the same stream into a scratch database, noted with kind/reason/ledger head), counts-only rotation in two pools, settings BACKUP_ENABLED (off by default), BACKUP_HOUR, BACKUP_EVERY_DAYS, BACKUP_KEEP (7), SAFETY_BACKUP_KEEP (3), an Earlier backups panel with administrator-only removal, Hotel Admin Scheduled backups card, edged relays, scd backup-now / backup-restore / marker-advance.
The legacy nightly site-backup job retired: units and helper removed by the installer, its backups preserved as earlier backups; the retention sweep never deletes a database backup.

The restore carries the financial guarantees of the retired script: proven quiesce, marker advanced before the swap (systemd-run), hypertable assertion, database-level grant carried across, recovery-mode record; scripts/edge-migrate.sh takes a mandatory pre-change backup on a live site.

The GDPR programme (D64): retention anonymisation, export/erase, assisted requests and the request register, encrypted backups, authenticator sign-in, the dual erasure ledger and its restore, migrations 0127-0148.
Migration 0149 (found live): an index so the hourly retention run finds a stay's events without reading the whole table.
found_during_live_verification: The retention run took 160 s on 374,000 stay events (no index on stay_events.stay_id) against a 30 s statement timeout: migration 0149 makes a batch of 500 stays take seven seconds.
edged's HTTP client capped every scd call at 15 s, so a backup and a verification that scd completes in 15-40 s were reported as failed: the default is now applied per call.
An SFTP server's password and the operator's step-up password were both 'password', so password authentication to the secondary storage could not work: sftp_password.

An erasure over a slow secondary storage hit the 15 s request timeout and edged's 5 s lock wait behind scd's ledger check: ledger routes now have four minutes, the lock wait is 45 s, a busy ledger is a plain refusal.
The status screen re-read every stored backup on each refresh: cached for 20 minutes. Hotel Admin's production build failed on a lint error the tests and tsc do not see (autoFocus).
keybootstrap must run at deploy for the new authenticator key, or scd refuses ALL Hotel Admin sign-in (operator_totp_dek.key).
